bias_targets.methodology: Literature review and conceptual analysis of algorithmic bias, citing examples like recidivism prediction algorithms (COMPAS) and face super-resolution models (PULSE) to illustrate harms from unrepresentative datasets and historical structural inequities.
Literature review and conceptual discussion illustrating illegitimate feature use in automated hiring systems and intersectional performance disparities in commercial facial analysis algorithms.

Qualitative case study and ethical critique of a specific 'gaydar' facial analysis model, evaluating its flawed methodology, reliance on spurious correlations (e.g., grooming and lifestyle), unrepresentative data, and failure to account for the fluidity of sexuality.
